trial_warning_t3.subject: 3 days left in your SOSH trial
trial_warning_t3.preheader: Keep your campaigns running — pick a plan before your trial ends.
trial_warning_t3.heading: Your trial ends in 3 days, {businessName}.
trial_warning_t3.lead: Your SOSH trial expires on {date}. Your active campaigns will pause and no new posts will be generated.
trial_warning_t3.supporting: Choose a plan now to keep everything running without interruption.

trial_warning_t1.subject: Last day of your SOSH trial
trial_warning_t1.preheader: Your trial ends tomorrow — choose a plan to keep going.
trial_warning_t1.heading: Your trial ends tomorrow, {businessName}.
trial_warning_t1.lead: Your SOSH trial expires tomorrow, on {date}. Your campaigns will pause and no new posts will be generated unless you choose a plan today.
trial_warning_t1.supporting: Pick a plan to keep your campaigns, posts, and analytics exactly as they are.

welcome_to_plan.subject: Welcome to SOSH {planName}
welcome_to_plan.preheader: Your plan is active — here's what's unlocked.
welcome_to_plan.heading: You're on SOSH {planName}, {businessName}.
welcome_to_plan.lead: Your subscription is active. Everything from your trial carries over — your campaigns, your posts, your brand voice.
welcome_to_plan.supporting: Open your dashboard to pick up where you left off.

payment_failed_courtesy.subject: A quick note about your SOSH payment
payment_failed_courtesy.preheader: We could not process your latest payment — here is how to fix it.
payment_failed_courtesy.heading: A note about your payment, {businessName}.
payment_failed_courtesy.lead: We weren't able to process your most recent payment. Your account is still active — we wanted to let you know so you can update your details at your convenience.
payment_failed_courtesy.supporting: Updating your payment method takes less than a minute. Nothing changes until you do.

first_post_published.subject: Your first post is live 🎉
first_post_published.preheader: SOSH just published your first post to {platform}.
first_post_published.heading: Your first post is live on {platform}. 🎉
first_post_published.lead: SOSH just published your first post to {platform}, {businessName}. The system is working.
first_post_published.supporting: Keep the cadence going — review your next drafts and keep your audience engaged.
